exclusions._comment: Reconciles the netted metrics back to raw. Excluded records are NOT dropped -- they stay in conversations[]/new_leads[] carrying the flag that excluded them.

reporting.leads_by_source_note: Counts are across all 223 currently-open opportunities in the two project pipelines (lifetime source attribution), not just today's window.
reporting.leads_by_tag_note: Counts are across all 223 currently-open opportunities in the two project pipelines (not lifetime). A few contacts carry duplicate opportunities across stages (e.g. Baljit Grewal, Ricardo Mendoza, Biplab Ghosh), so tag counts don't map 1:1 to unique contacts.
reporting.avg_days_in_stage_note: Cold and Postponed averages are heavily skewed by the 100-contact bulk-import batch frozen since pipeline launch (2025-10-29) and two 538-day Postponed records -- see workflow_drift stale_approaching/abandonment_next.
reporting.opportunity_status_counts_note: Across all three pipelines combined, lifetime totals (not a daily metric). Matches the documented ~297 won / ~1,132 abandoned scale, drifting slightly as records continue to close.
reporting.store_pipeline_note: STORE: Material Pipeline: 49 open / 6 won / 7 lost / 2 abandoned (64 total, lifetime). Same data quirk as prior runs: of the 49 open-status records, 13 sit in '6a. Closed - Won' and 4 in '6b. Closed - Lost' despite an open status -- unresolved, flagged again in stragglers_ranked. No stale thresholds are defined for this pipeline (its own +3d/+8d automated cadence).

stale_thresholds_used._comment: Echoed from platform-settings/ghl-workflow.json so the output is self-describing and a threshold change is visible in the diff.

meeting_window_summary._comment: The window any new Meeting-scheduled follow-up sequence must fit inside. Threshold counts from stage entry, so appointments booked far out shrink the usable runway.
meeting_window_summary.coverage_note: 3 future appointments matched via the calendar-events API flag; 11 past appointments matched via a manual conversation-activity lookup on the top abandonment_next records. 21 of 35 remain unsampled.

drift_findings_breakdown._comment: metrics.drift_findings is the sum of underlying affected records per category, not the count of report lines in workflow_drift (which aggregates large groups, e.g. the 97-record Oct-2025 batch, into single lines for readability).
